leaked_early.details: No public rumors or media reports of takeover speculation prior to the official announcement.

notes: Deal included a $5.00 CVR tied to FDA approval and sales milestones. Icosavax ran a targeted process after Phase 1 data, engaging 13 companies, but only AstraZeneca submitted a bid.
